title: AI assistance
description: Environment-managed assistance with human-controlled insert and replace.
emptyNoKeyDescription: Connect a key in agency settings, or ask an agency admin to enable AI assistance for this workspace.
agencyLevelDescription: AI is configured at the agency level. Workspace managers cannot change provider, model, or capability toggles — only agency admins can.
workspaceRequests30Days: Requests in this workspace, last 30 days
capabilitiesDescription: Each capability surfaces a button in the planning flow. Disabled capabilities stay hidden in the UI.

safety.drafts: AI drafts text; the human inserts or replaces — never auto-saves.
safety.allowlistedFields: Only allowlisted content fields are sent to the provider.
safety.usageLogs: Usage logs record categories and token counts, never full prompts.
safety.rateLimits: Rate limits protect users and provider spend; one retry on transient errors.

campaign_ideas.label: Campaign ideas
campaign_ideas.description: Generate 3-5 campaign ideas that ladder up to the active brief.

brief_improvement.label: Improve brief
brief_improvement.description: Tighten a vague brief into a clear Hook → Main message → CTA structure.

caption_drafts.label: Draft caption
caption_drafts.description: Draft a caption with platform-aware tone; editable before save.

platform_adaptation.label: Adapt to platform
platform_adaptation.description: Adapt a draft caption to a different channel (Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, X).

related_format_ideas.label: Related format ideas
related_format_ideas.description: Suggest adjacent formats for a piece of content (carousel ↔ reel ↔ story).

completeness_check.label: Check completeness
completeness_check.description: Score how ready a brief is for creative handoff and flag the missing pieces.
